statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds CVE-2026-75650, the Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source StyleSmuggler flaw patched 2026-09-07, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-29.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed at the deadline contains an entry with cveID CVE-2026-75650 and dateAdded between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-29 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: At the deadline the KEV catalog carries no entry for CVE-2026-75650 with a dateAdded on or before 2026-09-29.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds CVE-2026-44756 (SAP Kernel OVERPASS) or CVE-2026-58240 (SAP NetWeaver Message Server S4GET) with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed at the deadline contains an entry for CVE-2026-44756 or CVE-2026-58240 with dateAdded between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-06 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: At the deadline the KEV catalog carries neither CVE-2026-44756 nor CVE-2026-58240 with a dateAdded on or before 2026-11-06.

statement: The FRED series DCOILWTICO (WTI Cushing spot, dollars per barrel) prints at least one observation at or above 100.00 dated between 2026-09-09 and 2026-10-09. Reference: WTI 92.66 on the packet date per Section V.
resolution: TRUE if any FRED DCOILWTICO observation dated 2026-09-09 through 2026-10-09 inclusive is at or above 100.00 as published at the deadline; FALSE if all such observations are below 100.00.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO observation dated 2026-09-09 through 2026-10-09 is below 100.00.

statement: In the Swedish general election held 2026-09-13, the Social Democrats, Left Party, Green Party and Centre Party together win at least 175 of 349 Riksdag seats in the final count published by Valmyndigheten.
resolution: TRUE if the final Riksdag seat allocation published by Valmyndigheten for the 2026-09-13 election gives S, V, MP and C a combined 175 seats or more; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The final Valmyndigheten allocation gives S, V, MP and C a combined 174 seats or fewer.

statement: In the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election held 2026-09-20, the AfD receives the largest share of party list votes of any party in the official result published by the Landeswahlleiterin.
resolution: TRUE if the official preliminary or final result published by the Landeswahlleiterin Mecklenburg-Vorpommern for the 2026-09-20 election shows AfD with the highest party list vote percentage of any party; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: A party other than AfD holds the highest party list vote share in the official result.

statement: Between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-30, the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs announces that at least one Hungarian diplomat is expelled from Russia or declared persona non grata, following the Hungarian expulsion of 10 Russian diplomats reported 2026-09-08.
resolution: TRUE if a Russian MFA statement dated 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-30 announces expulsion or persona non grata status for at least one Hungarian diplomat, and Reuters or AFP reports it; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No Hungarian diplomat is expelled from Russia or declared persona non grata by the Russian MFA on any date from 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-30.

statement: Between 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-23, Saudi or Saudi-led coalition aircraft strike targets inside Sanaa city, with the strikes announced by the Saudi side and reported by Houthi-run Saba or Al Masirah on the same date.
resolution: TRUE if for at least one date 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-23 both a Saudi or coalition official statement and Houthi-run Saba or Al Masirah report coalition airstrikes inside Sanaa city; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No coalition airstrike inside Sanaa city is both acknowledged by the Saudi side and reported by Houthi media on any single date in the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-09 and 2026-10-31, the United States government and the government of Iran each publicly confirm a ceasefire, truce or halt of hostilities agreement between the two countries.
resolution: TRUE if on any date 2026-09-09 through 2026-10-31 an official US statement (White House, State Department or Pentagon) and an official Iranian statement (Foreign Ministry or SNSC) both confirm a ceasefire or halt of hostilities agreement; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No ceasefire, truce or halt of hostilities agreement is confirmed by both the US and Iranian governments on any date from 2026-09-09 through 2026-10-31.

statement: Between 2026-09-09 and 2026-11-30, French authorities announce at least one arrest or criminal charge of a suspect in the theft of Renoir paintings from the Musee Renoir in Cagnes-sur-Mer reported on 2026-09-08.
resolution: TRUE if a French prosecution office or French police announce at least one arrest or charge in the Musee Renoir Cagnes-sur-Mer theft on a date 2026-09-09 through 2026-11-30, reported by AFP or Le Monde; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No arrest or criminal charge in the Musee Renoir theft is announced by French authorities on any date from 2026-09-09 through 2026-11-30.

statement: The USGS catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with epicenter between 50.0N and 55.0N and between 175.0W and 165.0W (central and eastern Aleutians, the region of the 2026 M6.3 Nikolski event us7000tdvt), with origin time between 2026-09-10 and 2026-10-09 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query for magnitude 6.0 or greater events with epicenter in 50.0N to 55.0N and 175.0W to 165.0W, origin time 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-09 UTC inclusive, returns at least one event; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog contains no M6.0 or greater event inside the stated box with origin time from 2026-09-10 through 2026-10-09 UTC.
